description: This file contains shell script tests for verifying the behavior of git clone and fetch operations with promisor remotes, including settings related to lazy fetching and custom upload-pack scripts.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository directory.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a specified description and commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within the error output.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specified path does not exist.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks that a specified path exists and is a file.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script file with specified content.
